description: A component that receives data through inputs and reports user actions through outputs, with no service, HTTP call or business state.
A component that owns data access and screen state, passing values down to children and handling the events they emit.
A field that creates a read-only signal fed by the parent, where input.required makes the parent supply a value.
A field that creates an event the parent listens to with (name)="handler($event)" and that the component fires with emit.
A value computed from other signals, such as a cart total, which cannot disagree with its sources because it is not stored.
Replacing an array or object in a signal with a new one through update, which is how readers learn that the value changed.
